verification_policy: These records are sourced from the structured research corpus and remain partially_verified until acquisition, mechanics, and CaC availability are independently reconciled against canonical in-game evidence.
audit_note: Negative Ultimate Finish claims were removed where the research records did not carry explicit evidence establishing that an Ultimate Finish is not required. Unresolved cases remain null.

records.name: Divinity Unleashed
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 110 "Heretics from a Dark World"; 25% first-clear bonus slot according to the structured source; also listed at approximately 200 TP Medals in rotations.
records.skill_description: Ki charge that temporarily increases the amount of Ki gained after charging beyond its threshold.
records.mechanics_notes: The source describes a two-phase charge: an initial charge followed by a temporary Ki-gain increase. The buff improves Ki income from subsequent attacks and other Ki gains during its active window.
records.combo_notes: Primarily a resource-management skill rather than a combo attack; its value is in enabling subsequent Ki-intensive strings and skills.
records.pve_notes: Useful for longer PvE encounters where repeated attacks can take advantage of the temporary Ki-gain increase.
records.pvp_notes: The setup window creates interruption risk, so the source recommends treating it like other charge skills and using it during safe openings.

records.name: Super Dragon Fist
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after completing the story chapter "The Saiyan Threat"; listed by the structured source at 1,000 Zeni and 1 TP Medal in rotations.
records.source_quest_or_shop: Skill Shop; TP Medal Shop rotations
records.skill_description: Long-range Strike rush that leaps toward the target and follows with a maximum of three hits before knock-away.
records.mechanics_notes: The structured source describes long reach, fast startup, and straightforward combo integration. The final knock-away ends the sequence rather than extending it.
records.combo_notes: Designed as a gap-closing combo link; the source identifies its forward leap and simple confirmation as key properties.
records.pve_notes: Useful as an accessible early-game strike option and for closing distance against enemies outside normal melee range.
records.pvp_notes: Long reach and startup make it useful for catching opponents before they establish guard, while the knock-away limits continued pressure after the finisher.

records.name: God Splitter
records.unlock_method: Zamasu Instructor Quest 2; mentor training reward. The structured source states it is not sold in shops.
records.skill_description: Creates a Ki Blast in front of the user that can either be fired or canceled by guarding.
records.mechanics_notes: The defining mechanic is the guard cancel: the caster can form the projectile and then cancel the entire cast instead of firing. The structured source describes the fired version as a multi-hit projectile with knockback and the cancel as a conditioning/feint tool.
records.combo_notes: The source describes the fired version as combo filler because the caster can act after the projectile sequence.
records.pve_notes: Provides flexible mid-string damage and a cancel option useful for adapting to enemy behavior.
records.pvp_notes: The guard cancel can function as a feint, allowing the user to condition opponents to respect the projectile while preserving positioning when it is canceled.

records.name: Kaioken Assault
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after completing the story saga "The Ginyu Force Strikes"; structured source lists 5,000 Zeni and 2 TP Medals in rotations.
records.source_quest_or_shop: Skill Shop; TP Medal Shop rotations
records.skill_description: Kaioken rush that can be followed by an optional flurry; the extended flurry consumes the user's Health while it runs.
records.mechanics_notes: The initial charge can be used without triggering the Health-draining extension. A second input spends additional Ki and starts the flurry. The structured source reports that the flurry cannot be vanished out once it connects.
records.combo_notes: The charge-only stage can serve as a combo extender without invoking the Health cost of the follow-up flurry.
records.pve_notes: The optional flurry offers sustained damage when the user can safely absorb its Health cost.
records.pvp_notes: The charge stage provides a lower-commitment option, while the extended flurry carries a resource tradeoff and should be used from a reliable confirm.

records.name: Burst Rush
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 51 "Great Saiyaman is Here"; 30% on any clear according to the structured source; also listed at approximately 30 TP Medals in rotations.
records.skill_description: Counter stance that catches a qualifying melee attack and triggers a four-hit rush followed by knockdown.
records.mechanics_notes: The structured source specifies that the counter triggers against basic or Strike melee attacks, while Ki Blasts and beams do not trigger the stance. A roster-specific Gohan (DBS Super Hero) version adds a backward vanish before the rush.
records.combo_notes: Primarily a reactive counter rather than a conventional combo starter; a successful read automatically transitions into the rush sequence.
records.pve_notes: Can be effective against melee-focused AI that repeatedly attacks into counter windows.
records.pvp_notes: Its effectiveness depends on the opponent committing to melee attacks; ranged attacks bypass the counter condition and can punish the stance.
